attchmntText: Submission of Transcript of the Earnings conference call held with Analysts/Investors in respect of the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Omnitech Engineering Limited filed a notice regarding the transcript of the conference call with analysts and investors held on November 05, 2026, concerning the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The transcript is available on the company website. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue grew by 40.5% year-on-year to INR175.56 crores. EBITDA increased by 17.7% to INR51.25 crores. Profit before tax rose by 37.8% to INR40.33 crores. Profit after tax increased by 35.5% to INR30.57 crores. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue grew by 50% year-on-year to INR42.22 crores. EBITDA increased by 45.4% to INR101.87 crores. Profit before tax rose by 117.3% to INR80.01 crores. Profit after tax increased by 117% to INR60.29 crores. The order book as of October 31, 2026, stood at INR3,178 crores.
